privacy_body:
LiteTrans processes the files you pick on this computer. Source files and converted files stay on this computer or in the folder you choose, and are not uploaded to any server.

The app does not collect accounts, does not track usage, and does not require a network to convert.

After you turn on LAN access, other devices on the same network that have the address (and the password, if you set one) can view, play or preview, and download finished files. Conversion itself still does not require a network.
terms_body:
LiteTrans is for personally converting files you have the right to process. Make sure you have the necessary rights to the source files.

Output quality depends on the source file and the preset you choose. The app does not guarantee that every device can open the result. Conversion runs on this computer; interrupting, cancelling, or failing may leave incomplete files, which you can retry or clean up in history.
about_body:
LiteTrans {{version}}

LiteTrans is an on-device conversion tool. Files you pick stay on this computer, are not uploaded, and do not require a network. This version is a desktop app.
app_tagline: Convert from one format to another. Files stay on this computer.

hint_copy_mp4: Remux only — picture quality and resolution stay the same. The source video codec must fit in MP4; files that do not will ask you to use a regular conversion.
tune_intro: Quality is how hard it is compressed. Resolution is how large the picture is. You can keep original quality at 1080p: smaller picture, as much detail as possible.
quality_desc: How hard it is compressed, independent of picture size
quality_audio_desc: How much sound detail to keep, independent of picture size
quality_original_hint: Keep as much detail as possible
resolution_desc: How many pixels. Original size means no shrinking.
